title: type.describe, contract version 1
description: The editor descriptor of one type of the installation (PRD 11.12, 14.1), by its name. Every actor may run it without a permission, because it tells an actor only the shape of the type, filtered to what the actor may read, while the anonymous principal may not. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Schema\Domain\Queries\DescribeType, and the generated codec reads it and writes its canonical JSON. Its result is type.describe.result.v1.json.

name.description: The name of the type, <owner>:<handle>, such as app:blog_post.
